item.title: Blakely wins world all-around title after injury setbacks
item.description: American Skye Blakely won the women's all-around title at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships on Friday, completing a comeback from an Achilles injury that derailed her bid for the 2024 Paris Olympics.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: American Skye Blakely won the women's all-around title at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships on Friday, completing a comeback from an Achilles injury that derailed her bid for the 2024 Paris Olympics. The 21-year-old scored 55.733 points across vault, uneven bars, balance beam and floor exercise at Ahoy Arena to claim her first individual world title. Russia's Liudmila Roshchina took silver with 55.199, while China's Ke Qinqin, 16, finished third on 55.032. Blakely ruptured her right Achilles tendon during floor exercise training two days before the US Olympic trials in 2024, ending her bid to qualify for the Paris Games. She had also missed the Tokyo Olympic trials in 2021 after tearing an elbow ligament. The victory marks a breakthrough for Blakely, who previously won team gold at the 2022 and 2023 world championships but had not earned an individual world medal. She became the first American woman to win the world all-around title since Simone Biles in 2023.

item.title: Ｆ１＝米国ＧＰフリー走行、ルクレールが最速ラップ
item.description: ［オースティン（米テキサス州） ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２３日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第１８戦、米国グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２３日、米テキサス州オースティンでフリー走行を行い、フェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

フリー走行１回目に最速１分３６秒０５２を記録したルクレールは、２回目でトップタイムの１分３５秒２９１をマークした。

今週末の結果次第でＦ１史上最年少王者となるメルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）が０秒０４２差で２番手。昨年の米国ＧＰを制したレッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がルクレールと０秒１８９差で３番手に入った。

４番手はフェラーリのルイス・ハミルトンで、メルセデスのジョージ・ラッセル（ともに英国）が５番手で続いた。現王者でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）は、レーシングブルズのリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）に続く７番手となった。

item.title: US has for years asked Musk to alter Starlink service in Ukraine, Middle East, sources say
item.description: Well before the throttling this month of Ukraine's military access to Musk's satellite communications system, the Biden and Trump administrations had several times asked SpaceX to turn its Starlink service on or off in various countries, according to six former senior US officials.
item.dc:creator: Erin Banco, Joey Roulette
item.content:encoded: Well before the throttling this month of Ukraine's military access to Elon Musk's satellite communications system, the Biden and Trump administrations had several times asked SpaceX to turn its Starlink service on or off in various countries, according to six former senior US officials familiar with the matter. During the presidency of Joe Biden, the requests included switching off the service to prevent Iranian proxy militias in Yemen and Lebanon from using Starlink to communicate, and activating the service to provide internet access inside Iran and in Ukraine to support its military, said four of the former officials. Similarly, President Donald Trump's administration asked Musk, who is CEO of SpaceX, to make the service available in Iran following US-Israeli strikes in 2025 and 2026, in hopes it would bolster internet access and communications for anti-government protesters, a former senior Trump official and a person familiar with the matter told Reuters. All of the people spoke on condition of anonymity. The previous US requests about Starlink access are being reported here for the first time. The recent blowup over restrictions to Ukraine's use of SpaceX satellite services has raised questions about the ties between the US government and Musk, whose company owns systems vital to the US military and to US allies. The Biden-era and Trump requests to Musk show a close relationship in which US administrations rely to an unprecedented degree on a private-sector company to help implement foreign policy. The recent limits on Ukraine, despite being a US ally, have also rattled officials in Europe, some of whom argue that Europe must develop its own military satellite communications capabilities because no viable short-term alternative currently exists. STARSHIELD RESTRICTIONS HOBBLE UKRAINE MILITARY Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said last week that his country's access to Starshield, the military version of the Starlink system, had been intentionally limited, interfering with the performance of the country’s military drones. He also said the speeds were reduced for Starlink, which Ukraine uses for some military activities including defense against Russian missile attacks. Reuters has reported that [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"the order to throttle Starshield"] came from inside the White House. The Trump administration has acknowledged the slowdown but has not said whether it gave the order. The White House, contacted for comment, referred Reuters to Trump's remarks on Friday, when he said he had not spoken with Musk about Starlink access issues for Ukraine and that "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out." Halyna Yusypiuk, a spokesperson for the Ukrainian embassy in Washington, said Ukraine's priority is "to have the service restored to normal speed as soon as possible, as the lives of our people depend on it." SpaceX did not respond to requests for comment, although Musk said in a social media post earlier this week: “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately (by the president of the United States).” Democratic US Representative Jason Crow called on Friday for clarity about the recent changes to Ukraine's satellite service, saying there are risks to the US dependence on SpaceX. "Unelected billionaires and private corporations should not decide what is in the best interest of America's national security," Crow said. For Ukraine, the Starlink internet service has become the lifeblood of frontline communication between units, who say there is currently no rival to the capabilities of SpaceX's products. Starshield receivers, largely impervious to radio jamming, are used as onboard guidance systems and to provide links to a remote pilot for Ukrainian drones, including deep behind Russian lines inside Ukraine. MUSK'S INFLUENCE RAISES UNCERTAINTY Musk's role as the strong-willed CEO of a company with outsized influence over US national security has at times raised questions over who is making decisions about SpaceX's satellite services. The SpaceX CEO is "supposed to be a business executive, with government contracts, and he's essentially making huge foreign policy decisions," said Armand Musey, president of Summit Ridge Group, a satellite industry consultancy. "He's sufficiently ambiguous of a person that you don't know if his decisions are sort of his personal quirks, or it's because there's an influence elsewhere that's impacting him," Musey said. In previous years, Musk has moved to limit Ukraine’s access to Starlink. In 2022, according to Reuters reporting , Musk ordered SpaceX personnel to cut Starlink coverage in areas Ukraine was trying to retake, a move that surprised White House officials. Musk has said publicly that he refused a 2022 Ukrainian request to activate his satellite network in Crimea's port city of Sevastopol to aid an attack on Russia's fleet there, saying he feared complicity in a major act of war. The Biden administration at times relied on Musk to help implement policy, five of the former officials said. Biden officials coordinated with SpaceX to thwart US adversaries by cutting the service, and to help allies by expanding Starlink’s availability, they said. They added that discussions between the government and SpaceX, which usually included Pentagon and White House officials, often focused on preventing groups such as the Iranian-linked Houthis in Yemen and Hezbollah in Lebanon from using Starlink terminals. Biden officials several times shared intelligence with SpaceX that indicated that the Houthis and Hezbollah were using diverted Starlink terminals — hardware that made its way to the militants through intermediaries. In October 2023, during fighting between Israel and Hezbollah militants in southern Lebanon, intelligence officials told the White House that individuals linked to Hezbollah could have gained access to Starlink terminals. Officials had similar concerns about the Houthis in Yemen in 2024 during a US air campaign against the Iran-linked group, five of the officials said. In both cases, the administration contacted SpaceX and asked it to identify the terminals and shut them off. At least some of the terminals were deactivated, said two of the officials. In a 2024 submission to the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, SpaceX said it works closely with US government agencies to secure export authorizations where required and to safeguard technology in support of US national security objectives and foreign policy goals. Soon after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Biden officials pushed SpaceX to expand Starlink use for the Ukrainian military, said two of the former officials. In a separate instance, the Biden administration asked SpaceX to turn on Starlink in Iran during a protest movement launched in September 2022 after the death of Mahsa Amini, an Iranian arrested for not wearing her hijab properly, according to one of the former officials. Starlink terminals were moved into the country with the help of the administration, said the official, who declined to say how many were transferred. The Trump administration took a similar step earlier this year and discussed with Musk and SpaceX getting Starlink terminals into Iran and activated following US-Israeli strikes in the country in June 2025 and again in February 2026, a former senior Trump official and a person familiar with the matter told Reuters. Neither the Trump administration nor SpaceX has publicly confirmed that those terminals were turned on. The Wall Street Journal reported in February that the US government had sent thousands of Starlink terminals into Iran. Iran's delegation to the UN did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: サッカー＝伊藤所属バイエルンのコンパニ監督、練習中に倒れ病院に搬送
item.description: ［ミュンヘン（ドイツ） ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンは２３日、バンサン・コンパニ監督が練習中に倒れ、病院に搬送されたと発表した。

コンパニ監督は最近、ウイルス感染症を患い、チームの練習を何度か欠席していた。クラブの発表によると、同監督はセカンドチームの練習を見学中に倒れ、医療処置を受けた。現在は病院で精密検査を受けており、引き続き医師の管理下に置かれる。当面はコーチ陣が練習や試合の指揮を執るという。

バイエルンはドイツ１部で首位に立っており、今週行われた欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）ではアーセナル（イングランド）とホームで２─２の引き分け。２５日には鈴木唯人、山本理仁、後藤啓介が所属するフライブルクと敵地で対戦する予定となっている。

item.title: Los disturbios disparan las ventas de armas de autodefensa en las ciudades más afectadas de Francia
item.description: Los comerciantes franceses refuerzan la seguridad de sus negocios ante una nueva jornada de disturbios. Las ventas de armas de autodefensa se han multiplicado por diez en las ciudades más afectadas.
item.dc:creator: Angelina Rascouet
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — A última hora de la mañana del viernes, Sam salió de una tienda de caza en el centro de París, tras haber gastado EUR$600 (US$671) en armas destinadas a la autodefensa. El tendero, que se negó a dar su apellido por motivos de seguridad, es propietario de una joyería de bisutería en Les Halles, un extenso distrito comercial. Su negocio se libró de los alborotadores que saquearon las tiendas cercanas el pasado fin de semana, pero quiere estar preparado por si se producen nuevos episodios de violencia. Ver más: Francia desplegará militares para contener nuevas protestas este fin de semana Entre sus compras figuraban una porra, así como una pistola de plástico que dispara pequeños cartuchos de una sustancia similar al gas lacrimógeno. A diferencia de lo que ocurre en gran parte de Estados Unidos, la compra de armas de fuego en Francia está estrictamente restringida. Sam también ha contratado a guardias de seguridad privados con perros y está tapiando sus escaparates. A pesar de sus preocupaciones, tiene previsto abrir el negocio. “Nunca pensé que se llegaría a esto”, afirmó. “Estoy tomando estas medidas, pero no me siento tranquilo”. Las protestas del pasado sábado en toda Francia degeneraron en actos de vandalismo y violencia, cuando grupos itinerantes de alborotadores atacaron cientos de tiendas, rompiendo escaparates y llevándose la mercancía. Desde entonces, los disturbios se han calmado, pero dado que los manifestantes han convocado otra jornada de disturbios para este sábado, los residentes, las autoridades y los comerciantes están en vilo. Sam compró su equipo en l’Armurerie de la Bourse, cuyo propietario, Yves Gollety, preside la organización que representa a los vendedores de armas en toda Francia —un cargo que le proporciona una perspectiva nacional—. Ver más: Macron acusa a líderes extranjeros de aprovecharse de los disturbios en Francia Su tienda está registrando unos niveles de actividad extraordinarios, según afirmó, y no es la única. Gollety, que suele atender a cazadores y tiradores deportivos, calcula que las ventas de armas para la autodefensa se han multiplicado por diez en las ciudades que han sufrido los mayores disturbios, como París, Marsella, Lyon y Burdeos. “La gente quedó traumatizada por lo ocurrido el pasado fin de semana, cuando en ocasiones se vieron solos, a veces durante dos o tres horas o incluso todo el día, enfrentándose a los alborotadores”, explicó Gollety. “Los comerciantes, los propietarios de restaurantes y los particulares se asustaron y buscan defenderse. No pretenden tomarse la justicia por su mano”. Si bien las ventas tradicionales de rifles de caza se han desplomado, la demanda de sprays de pimienta, botes similares al gas lacrimógeno, pistolas que disparan balas de goma y otros equipos no letales se ha disparado. El aumento de las ventas no tiene “precedentes”, señaló Gollety, y es más pronunciado que en episodios anteriores de disturbios y agitación social. La tienda de Gollety estuvo abierta el sábado pasado, pero no sufrió daños, a pesar de que otros comercios de la zona fueron atacados y saqueados. Tiene previsto abrir mañana, aunque solo sea para proteger su tienda. Ver más: Violencia en Francia eleva las alertas en Europa ante nuevas protestas y elecciones La Prefectura de Policía instó a los propietarios de negocios a contratar a más agentes de seguridad privada antes del sábado, lo que provocó la ira de muchos, entre ellos Eric Larcheveque, cofundador de Ledger, fabricante de carteras de hardware para criptomonedas. Este escribió en X que, si el Estado ya no puede proteger a la población, los franceses deberían dejar de pagar impuestos. -Con la colaboración de Julius Domoney. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: サッカー＝サウジでのアジア杯開催、治安情勢受け困難か 宮本会長が見解
item.description: ［東京 ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［東京　２３日　ロイター］ - 日本サッカー協会の宮本恒靖会長は２３日、サウジアラビアの治安情勢を踏まえ、来年のアジア・カップ（杯）を予定通り同国で開催するのは容易ではないとの認識を示した。

サウジではイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃が激化する中、主要なスポーツイベントの中止や延期が相次いでいる。来年１月７日から２月５日まで予定されているアジア杯の開催にも不透明感が広がっている。

宮本会長は東京で開かれたアジア・サッカー連盟（ＡＦＣ）の臨時総会で記者団に対し、報道を通じて把握している限りでは現地の安全が確保されておらず、現時点での開催は難しいとの見方を示した。

また、サウジ側との会談では、選手やファン、大会関係者らの安全を最優先する方針が伝えられたと説明。サウジ側からは、開催の可否をＡＦＣと協議して判断するため、結論が出るまでには時間がかかるとの説明もあったという。

ＡＦＣ会長は先週、必要であれば大会を２０２８年に延期する可能性もあると述べたが、その後、地元大会組織委員会は当初の日程通り開催する方針を示していた。

item.title: Tyrrell Hatton, Ian Poulter join LIV Golf exodus
item.description: LIV Golf lost two more big-name players, with Englishmen Tyrrell Hatton and Ian Poulter announcing Friday they will not sign on for LIV 2.0.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LIV Golf lost two more big-name players, with Englishmen Tyrrell Hatton and Ian Poulter announcing Friday they will not sign on for LIV 2.0. Hatton, 35, posted a brief statement to Instagram announcing his decision. "Wanted to confirm that I will not be a part of LIV 2.0," he wrote. "A big thank you to everyone for continued support," he continued. "I am excited for what the next chapter of my career holds." Hatton joined LIV in 2024 and had one tournament win -- LIV Nashville that same year. He was part of captain Jon Rahm's Legion XIII, winner of the 2025 season championship. Poulter, 50, said he made his decision after discussing his playing future with his family and team. "Ultimately, the opportunity to spend more time at home with my family, reduce international travel, focus on senior golf and have the opportunity to pursue other interests was something that I felt was right for me at this stage of my life and career," Poulter said in an Instagram post. Poulter was among the first players to sign with LIV Golf at its inception in 2022. He and countryman Lee Westwood have been two of the most outspoken supporters of the Saudi-backed league, which has been accused by many critics of dividing the professional golf world. Poulter and Westwood served as the co-captains of the all-English Majesticks GC that included Laurie Canter and Sam Horsfield for the 2026 season. Majesticks finished 12th in the 13-team league. Tom McKibbin added his name to the list later Friday when he announced his decision to play full-time on the DP World Tour going forward. The 23-year-old native of Northern Ireland, who counts Rory McIlroy as a countryman and mentor, won one DP World Tour event before joining Rahm and Legion XIII in 2025. "Joining LIV Golf was the right decision for me at the time, and I'm grateful for everything it has given me," McKibbin wrote on Instagram. "... I've taken time to think about what's best for me and I am confident (returning to the DP World Tour) is the right decision to help me achieve my goals." Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund announced earlier this year that it would end its financial support of LIV Golf. CEO Scott O'Neil has lined up funding for LIV 2.0 as the league goes through Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings, with plans to play a 10-event schedule in 2027 that includes five events in the United States and five internationally. However, Hatton, Poulter and McKibbin join a growing list of players who will not return that includes Rahm, Sergio Garcia and David Puig of Spain, as well as Abraham Ancer, Charles Howell III, Adrian Meronk, Louis Oosthuizen and Thomas Pieters. Other marquee names, including Bryson DeChambeau, Cam Smith and Joaquin Niemann, have not declared yet what they intend to do by Sunday's registration deadline. "Clearly, LIV Golf has divided opinion," Poulter wrote. "But to be part of the founding group that took world class golf around the globe, showcased our great game to a new audience, built a team brand in Majesticks GC, helped innovate tournament formats and establish a leading community impact program in Little Sticks, is something I will be forever proud of. And that's just scratching the surface of what we achieved together. "Change is never easy and it's fair to say professional golf has experienced plenty of it over the last few years. But I've always believed that change can create opportunity and ultimately lead to positive outcomes. There will undoubtedly be more changes ahead, but I am confident the game will continue to grow, evolve, and deliver the very best for golf fans around the world." Poulter will likely need to serve a one-year suspension from the date of his most recent LIV event before being eligible to play on the Champions Tour, similar to former LIV player Henrik Stenson, who made his Champions debut earlier this year. The DP World Tour has also announced it will not grant membership to LIV Golf players in 2027, which Poulter needs in order to be eligible to be a Ryder Cup captain or vice captain for Europe in the future. Meanwhile, Poulter's eldest son, Luke, 22, plays golf for the University of Florida and has competed in the Walker Cup. Joshua Poulter, 14, is his youngest son. Ian and his wife, Katie, also have two daughters. He said he plans to devote more time to helping Luke and Joshua in their golf pursuits and also growing his YouTube channel. "I'm genuinely excited about this next chapter. I'm looking forward to spending more time with my family, continuing to develop The Postman YouTube channel, sharing more of my life, golf, experiences and competing in some senior events," Poulter wrote. "Something I am also particularly looking forward to is being able to spend more time helping Luke as he pursues his career in professional golf, and Joshua as he looks to develop as a golfer in his teenage years. Having spent so many years travelling the world chasing my own golfing dreams, the opportunity to now spend more time supporting my boys as they chase theirs is something that means a great deal to me. "After all these years, golf has given me so much, and I'm excited about what lies ahead, both on and off the course. Thanks again to everyone who has been part of the journey so far! We certainly aren't done yet!" --Field Level Media

item.title: フランス格下げ回避、ムーディーズが据え置き決定 社会不安続く中
item.description: ［パリ ２３日 ロイター］ - 格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。社会不安の抑制と厳...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
フランス格下げ回避、ムーディーズが据え置き決定　社会不安続く中 9:20 配信

22日、パリで学生団体や労働組合が主催した抗議行動の最中、警戒にあたるフランス機動隊（ＣＲＳ）の隊員たち　REUTERS/Abdul Saboor

［パリ　２３日　ロイター］ - 格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ格好だ。

ムーディーズは格付けの定期見直しを終え、「Ａａ３」に据え置いたと発表した。見通しは２０２５年１０月以降、「ネガティブ」としている。

債券市場は格下げを織り込んでいた。格下げされれば、既に格下げしていたＳ＆Ｐ、フィッチにムーディーズも足並みをそろえる形になるところだった。フランスでは２４年の解散総選挙でどの勢力も議会の過半数を確保できず、政治がまひ状態に陥り、財政再建が難航している。

仏財務省は声明で、格付け据え置きは「政府が２７年予算法案で示した予算の信頼性を反映している。この予算は、財政再建の軌道を維持することを目指している」と表明した。

ムーディーズは声明で「Ａａ３の格付けは、財政赤字の削減を盛り込んだ２７年予算が成立し、今後数カ月で資金調達コストが幾分低下し、社会的緊張もやや緩和することを前提としている」と説明した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める アングル：アルゼンチンのカントリーリスク低下、国際資本市場復帰論が活発化 アングル：「オルバン長期政権後」に賭ける投資家、ハンガリー総選挙に期待 コラム：オープンＡＩ投資で膨らむソフトバンクの財務リスク 焦点：「氷雪経済」の成功例追え、中国がサービス投資にテコ入れ 最終更新: 10/24(土) 9:20 ロイター

item.title: Legendary Rams RB Lawrence McCutcheon dies at 76
item.description: Legendary Los Angeles Rams running back Lawrence McCutcheon died Friday after a battle with Parkinson's disease. He was 76.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Legendary Los Angeles Rams running back Lawrence McCutcheon died Friday after a battle with Parkinson's disease. He was 76. McCutcheon was a Pro Bowl selection in five straight seasons (1973-77) for the Rams and still ranks fourth all-time on the club's rushing list with 6,186 yards over eight seasons from 1972-79. McCutcheon was the franchise's leading rusher when his Los Angeles career ended. He now ranks behind Marshall Faulk (6,959), Eric Dickerson (7,245) and Steven Jackson (10,138) on the club's list. "It is with great sadness that we share the passing of our husband, brother, father, grandfather, and great grandfather, Lawrence McCutcheon," McCutcheon's family said in a statement. "Clutch passed away on October 23 with family at his bedside following a long, courageous battle with Parkinson's disease. "Through a decade-long playing career and another 32 years in the Rams' front office, Clutch earned the respect and admiration of teammates, opposing players, colleagues, and fans alike. Clutch will be missed and remembered forever. We are thankful to those in our community who have reached out with love and support." McCutcheon finished his playing career with the Denver Broncos (1980), Seattle Seahawks (1980) and Buffalo Bills (1981). Overall, he rushed for 6,578 yards and 26 touchdowns and caught 198 passes for 1,799 yards and 13 scores in 109 career games (82 starts). McCutcheon participated in 11 playoff games for the Rams and famously threw a 24-yard touchdown pass to Ron Smith in the third quarter of Super Bowl XIV. That gave Los Angeles a 19-17 lead before it eventually lost 31-19 to the Pittsburgh Steelers on Jan. 20, 1980. McCutcheon was a third-round pick in 1972 out of Colorado State, also known as the Rams. He played at Colorado State from 1969-71 and still ranks seventh all-time in rushing yards (2,917). McCutcheon was inducted into the Colorado State Athletics Hall of Fame in 1989. After his playing career, McCutcheon returned to the Rams as a scout in 1982 and served in many roles -- including director of player personnel for seven years -- before retiring in 2016. "The Los Angeles Rams are deeply saddened by the passing of Lawrence McCutcheon," the team said in a statement. "His impact on this organization spanned generations, and he embodied what it means to be a Ram. A five-time Pro Bowl running back and once the franchise's all-time leading rusher, he later served in our front office as a scout and director of player personnel. His legacy is woven into the fabric of our team. We extend our heartfelt condolences to the McCutcheon family as we celebrate a life that gave so much to the Rams and to our game." Cornerback Daylon McCutcheon, the son of Lawrence, was a member of the Cleveland Browns from 1999-2006. McCutcheon's family asked that, in lieu of flowers, those wishing to honor him please donate to the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research. --Field Level Media

item.title: Líder da Coreia do Norte pede “revolução militar” ao exigir unidades militares mais fortes
item.description: O líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un pediu que as companhias do Exército do país fossem transformadas em unidades de combate de elite e autossuficientes durante uma reunião de dois dias de comandantes de companhia em Pyongyang, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA no sábado (horário local).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un pediu que as companhias do Exército do país fossem transformadas em unidades de combate de elite e autossuficientes durante uma reunião de dois dias de comandantes de companhia em Pyongyang, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA no sábado (horário local). O evento ressaltou a prioridade política consistente de Kim de fortalecer as Forças Armadas. Em um discurso proferido na conferência de comandantes de companhias do Exército da Coreia do Norte, realizada nos dias 22 e 23 de outubro — que, segundo a KCNA, foi o primeiro encontro de todo o Exército desde o 9º Congresso do partido governista da Coreia do Norte, em fevereiro —, Kim pediu que todas as companhias se preparassem plenamente para que “a meta do fortalecimento militar da nova era” pudesse ser alcançada. “Vamos tornar o Exército mais forte e acelerar uma revolução militar ao nosso estilo”, disse Kim. Durante o 9º Congresso do partido governista da Coreia do Norte, em fevereiro — que define os rumos do país para os próximos cinco anos —, Kim pediu o fortalecimento das Forças Armadas convencionais, além de reafirmar os esforços para desenvolver armas nucleares e mísseis.

item.title: ゴルフ＝ＢＭＷ女子選手権、岩井千と吉田が6位 首位と4打差
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのＢＭＷ女子選手権は２３日、韓国南西部・海南のパインビーチ・リンクス（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、岩井千怜と吉田優利が通算９アンダーの１３５で６位につけた。

前日首位の吉田は４バーディー、１ボギーの６９で回り、６位に後退。首位とは４打差となった。８位スタートだった岩井千怜は２イーグル、５バーディー、１ボギー、１ダブルボギーの６６をマークした。

２９位で出た岩井明愛は６７で回り、通算６アンダーの１３８で１５位に浮上。前日１８位の畑岡奈紗は６９をマークし、通算５アンダーの１３９で２３位に後退した。

勝みなみは４５位、古江彩佳は５６位、竹田麗央は７５位、原英莉花は８０位だった。

ユ・ヘラン（韓国）が２イーグル、４バーディーの６４、通算１３アンダーの１３１として首位に浮上。ローレン・コフリン（米国）らが２打差の２位で追いかけている。

item.title: サッカー＝町野が得点、宇野が初アシスト ボルシアＭＧは初白星
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは２３日、１試合を行い、町野修斗が今季２ゴール目を挙げたボルシアＭＧは敵地でシュツットガルトに３─２で勝利した。

町野と橋岡大樹、宇野禅斗の日本人３選手が先発したボルシアＭＧは、前半５分に先制を許す。それでも、同３８分には宇野がボレーシュートを放つと、ゴール前のジョー・スカリーが右足ヒールでコースを変えてネットを揺らし、同点に追いついた。宇野は今夏のチーム加入後初アシスト。

さらにボルシアＭＧは後半６分、味方の折り返しから正面の町野が左足でシュートを沈めて逆転。チームは同２１分にも追加点を奪ってリードを広げると、その後に１点を返されるも逃げ切った。

リーグ開幕から６連敗だったボルシアＭＧは、７戦目で初白星。橋岡と宇野がフル出場し、町野は後半３９分までプレーした。板倉滉はメンバー外だった。

item.title: 陸上＝競歩の池田、ドーピング違反処分取り消し 競技復帰可能に
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - スポーツ仲裁裁判所（ＣＡＳ）は２３日、陸上男子２０キロ競歩で２０２１年東京五輪銀メダリストの池田向希（２８）に科されていた４年間の資格停止処分を取り消すと発表した。ドーピング違反が立証されなかったとして池田の不服申し立てを認め、ただちに競技復帰が可能となった。

池田は選手の血液データを蓄積する「生体パスポート」の数値に異常が見られたことからドーピングを疑われ、２４年１１月に暫定的な資格停止処分を受けた。２５年２月には世界陸連から４年間の資格停止処分を科された。

一貫してドーピングを否定してきた池田は同年３月にＣＡＳへ不服を申し立て、今年５月にスイスのローザンヌで聴聞会が開かれた。

ＣＡＳは生体パスポートの複数の数値に異常があったことを認めた一方、ドーピング以外の合理的な説明が可能と判断。池田側が提出した医学的証拠や専門家の意見により、世界陸連の裁定機関による審理時よりも幅広い事実関係が明らかになったとし、違反は立証されていないと結論付けた。

池田は２２年世界選手権でも銀メダルを獲得し、２４年パリ五輪では７位だった。今回の裁定により、２８年ロサンゼルス五輪への出場にも道が開けた。

item.title: ゴルフ＝バミューダ選手権、首位浮上の平田「久しぶりの優勝争い」
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフのバミューダ選手権は２３日、英領バミューダ、サウサンプトンのポートロイヤルＧＣ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、平田憲聖が首位に浮上した。

前日１１位の平田は７バーディー、ノーボギーの６４をマークし、通算１３アンダーの１２９でトップに立った。「久しぶりの優勝争いなので、週末はいろいろな感情が湧いてくると思うが、これまでの６勝が助けになると思う」とコメント。同選手は日本ツアーで６勝を挙げている。

１１位スタートの米沢蓮は３アンダーの６８で回り、通算９アンダーの１３３で１３位に後退。初日は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６５を記録していた。金谷拓実は６３位。

前日首位のチャンドラー・ブランシェ（米国）は最終１８番でバーディーを奪うなど、４アンダーの６７をマークし、平田と並ぶ首位を維持した。

item.title: Boeing supplier dispute has halted 777 freighter production for two months, sources say
item.description: Boeing's dispute with a small Florida-based supplier has halted production of its 777 freighter for nearly two months and disrupted output of the 767, including freighters and KC-46 aerial refueling tankers, according to Boeing workers and court filings.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Boeing's (BA.N) dispute with a small Florida-based supplier has halted production of its 777 freighter for nearly two months and disrupted output of the 767, including freighters and KC-46 aerial refueling tankers, according to Boeing workers and court filings. Boeing filed a complaint in August alleging supplier Vaero had stopped delivering a critical wing component known as the trailing-edge rib kit, stalling work at the Everett, Washington, wing-production facility that supports the 777 freighter and 767 programs, according to a copy of the complaint reviewed by Reuters. The disruption was costing Boeing as much as $6.5 million a day, the complaint said. Boeing said in the complaint that the trailing-edge rib kit was an "indispensable" part and Vaero was the sole supplier. Although the companies reached a settlement in late September, production of the 777 freighter has yet to resume, according to three Boeing workers familiar with the matter. They declined to be named because they were not authorized to speak publicly. The dispute also disrupted production of the 767, a widebody cargo and military aircraft, the people said. Since the settlement, Boeing has received some parts for the 767 line, according to one of the workers. The prolonged disruption highlights the fragility of aerospace supply chains, showing how a dispute involving a single supplier can halt production of aircraft that remain in strong demand. The lawsuit was first reported by Law.com in August, but the nearly two-month production disruption has not previously been reported. Boeing declined to comment. Vaero did not respond to requests for comment. BRINGING PRODUCTION IN-HOUSE Boeing is trying to bring production of the trailing-edge rib kit in-house, according to two of the people. The component is used in wing assembly for the 767 and current-generation 777 freighter. Boeing's 777X, which uses composite wings, has not been affected. Without the Vaero parts, Boeing removed two partially assembled 777 freighters from its final assembly line, according to one Boeing worker. Using data from aviation consultancy IBA, Reuters identified one of the aircraft as destined for FedEx (FDX.N) . FedEx did not respond to a request for comment. Boeing has delivered 21 777 freighters so far this year, company data show. It also has a handful of freighters whose wings were assembled before the dispute and could still be delivered before year-end, according to two of the Boeing workers.

item.title: Moderna y Merck enfrentan dudas de inversionistas pese a los avances de su vacuna contra el melanoma
item.description: La vacuna personalizada redujo un 42% el riesgo de recurrencia del melanoma y un 38% el de diseminación a distancia. Sin embargo, los datos filtrados generaron dudas entre los inversionistas sobre su ...
item.dc:creator: Michelle Fay Cortez, Robert Langreth
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los datos filtrados del tan esperado ensayo clínico de la vacuna contra el melanoma de Moderna Inc. ( MRNA ) y Merck & Co. ( MRK ) han generado una inusual discrepancia entre los médicos, que celebraron sus resultados, y Wall Street, donde se produjo una venta masiva de acciones. Normalmente, los resultados de este tipo de ensayos clínicos decisivos son binarios: médicos, pacientes e inversores descubren si un nuevo medicamento marcará una diferencia significativa en la vida de las personas y llegan a la misma conclusión. En cambio, a medida que se filtraban en las redes sociales informes sobre los resultados de la vacuna contra el melanoma, días antes de la presentación cuidadosamente preparada que tenía previsto ofrecer ante miles de oncólogos reunidos en Madrid con motivo del congreso de la Sociedad Europea de Oncología Médica, esas realidades divergieron. Ver más: Moderna cae un récord de 26% tras filtrarse datos de su vacuna contra el melanoma con Merck La vacuna personalizada contra el cáncer desarrollada por Moderna y Merck ayudó claramente a los pacientes, reduciendo en un 42% la probabilidad de que sus tumores reaparecieran tras su extirpación quirúrgica y previniendo su diseminación a distancia en un 38%. Sin embargo, las acciones de ambas farmacéuticas cayeron, y la caída de Moderna alcanzó niveles récord durante la sesión bursátil de este jueves. Los resultados suponen un gran avance para el melanoma, uno de los tipos de cáncer más comunes, y podrían constituir una nueva y potente herramienta para tratar numerosas formas operables de la enfermedad. La vacuna podría ayudar a muchos miles de personas con melanoma que presentan un alto riesgo de recidiva. Este tipo de resultados suelen sentar las bases para la aprobación de nuevos medicamentos, y los médicos acogieron con satisfacción los hallazgos. “Estoy bastante impresionado”, aseguró Michael Postow, especialista en melanoma del Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center y uno de los investigadores. Los beneficios podrían incrementar con el tiempo, señaló. “Es probable que, hasta ahora, no hayamos visto el efecto terapéutico completo de todo esto”. Incluso tras la caída de este jueves, las acciones de Moderna siguen estando muy por encima del nivel en el que se encontraban antes de que la compañías anunciara en agosto que la vacuna era eficaz, sin presentar el conjunto completo de datos. Wall Street, no obstante, ha revisado a la baja algunas de sus expectativas más optimistas respecto a la empresa biotecnológica tras la publicación de esta semana. Había descontado la idea de que la vacuna fuera el punto de partida de una línea oncológica más amplia que Moderna ha estado tratando de desarrollar, y que algún día podría incluir tratamientos similares para el cáncer de pulmón, de vejiga y otros tipos de cáncer. Los datos limitados han suscitado ciertas dudas sobre lo difícil que resultaría ello, al mostrar que la capacidad para prevenir la diseminación a distancia podría no ser tan sólida como se esperaba. La información disponible no ha infundido confianza en algunos inversionistas de Moderna, que apostaban por el giro de la empresa tras la Covid-19 para convertirse en una importante empresa dedicada al cáncer. “Aunque la aprobación parece probable, el éxito comercial es mucho menos seguro”, escribió Trung Huynh, analista de RBC Capital Markets, en una nota dirigida a los inversionistas. Los datos plantean “cuestiones fundamentales” sobre la propuesta de valor de la vacuna en comparación con el tratamiento de referencia actual, que ofrece beneficios similares a un coste potencialmente mucho menor, señaló. Ver más: Moderna se dispara 160% y deja millonarias pérdidas a quienes apostaban por su caída El éxito de la vacuna contra el melanoma también someterá a Moderna y Merck a la presión de completar los ensayos en otros tipos de cáncer, incluso cuando surgen dudas sobre las ventas a corto plazo y el mercado potencialmente más amplio para dicha tecnología. “Se trata de una forma extraordinariamente compleja y potencialmente costosa de fabricar fármacos”, afirmó Lennard Lee, profesor asociado de la Universidad de Oxford. “La logística podría hacer que Amazon pareciera sencilla”. Todos los pacientes del estudio recibieron además Keytruda, el fármaco oncológico más vendido de Merck, lo que convierte a las vacunas personalizadas diseñadas para cada paciente en una terapia complementaria. Los beneficios adicionales, junto con la ausencia de efectos secundarios graves, podrían convencer a más pacientes de optar por este tratamiento, señaló Sekwon Jang, director de investigación y terapias contra el melanoma e investigador clínico del Inova Schar Cancer Institute, en el norte de Virginia. Ver más: FDA aprueba medicamento contra cáncer de piel avanzado para pacientes sin respuesta a inmunoterapia “Con esta combinación, creo que la relación riesgo-beneficio es, de hecho, mucho más favorable”, explicó Jang. “Espero que más pacientes míos opten por recibir este tratamiento combinado”, agregó, si finalmente se aprueba. No obstante, los inversionistas ya esperaban resultados sólidos después de que las empresas emitieran un comunicado de prensa en agosto en el que se indicaba que el estudio había tenido éxito, y algo más. Esa noticia avivó las expectativas respecto al uso de la tecnología de ARNm de Moderna, diseñada para permitir a los médicos preparar el sistema inmunitario para detectar y destruir invasores extraños y otras amenazas, incluidas las células tumorales. Luego de décadas con resultados decepcionantes, estos hallazgos podrían suponer un real avance en el desarrollo de una vacuna contra el cáncer dirigida a los tumores sólidos. Aun así, los detalles de los resultados del estudio todavía no se han presentado en su totalidad a los médicos ni a los inversionistas, y se necesitan para evaluar su potencial y validar sus expectativas. Los resultados serán presentados este sábado en Madrid, donde un grupo más amplio de oncólogos evaluará los hallazgos. -Con la colaboración de Madison Muller. Lea más en Bloomberg

item.title: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
item.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Amazon (AMZN.O) CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure. In a video podcast with Andreessen Horowitz co-founder Ben Horowitz and general partner Erik Torenberg, Jassy said Amazon is struggling to keep pace with the insatiable demand from AI labs and enterprises. Earlier this year, Amazon had said it would spend [USN:L4N43X10O TEXT:"about $220 billion"] in capital expenditure for 2026 Jassy said the company "could invest a lot more and it wouldn't be a bad use of capital," considering cloud-computing capacity for 2026 is already sold out "2027 is largely sold out. We always leave a certain amount for on demand and our inference service bedrock, or EC2, but largely sold out all the big chunks. A good chunk of 2028 is sold out," he said EC2 is an AWS service that provides cloud servers for running applications, while Bedrock gives customers access to AI models to build generative AI applications Amazon is scheduled to report third quarter results on October 29

item.title: Bulls storm back from early deficit to beat Bucks
item.description: Norman Powell scored 25 points and rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 on Friday to help the visiting Chicago Bulls earn a 132-125 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Norman Powell scored 25 points and rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 on Friday to help the visiting Chicago Bulls earn a 132-125 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks. Leonard Miller had 19 points, while Jalen Smith chipped in 14 points and 13 rebounds for Chicago, which rebounded after suffering a 43-point loss to the Toronto Raptors on Wednesday. Buddy Hield scored 13, Isaac Okoro had 12 and Tre Jones tallied 11 points and eight assists for the Bulls, who trailed by 15 points after the first quarter. Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 34 points, followed by Jaime Jaquez Jr.'s 19 points and 11 boards. Kyle Kuzma scored 14 and Myles Turner had 12, while Ryan Rollins, AJ Green and Kel'el Ware scored 11 apiece for the Bucks, who lost their second straight to open the season. Rookie Brayden Burries made a 3-pointer and Ware scored around the rim to give the Bucks a five-point lead with 2:55 left in the third quarter. Smith beat the third-quarter buzzer with a dunk that cut the Bulls' deficit to 104-102 entering the fourth. Chicago scored the first six points of the final quarter and grabbed a 108-104 lead on Wilson's slam. The Bulls pushed the lead to eight on Hield's trey with 7:19 remaining. With Milwaukee trailing by five, Herro connected on back-to-back 3-pointers, returning the lead to the Bucks. Wilson made two free throws to put the Bulls ahead 124-123 with 1:16 left. After Jones picked off Rollins' pass, Wilson made another pair from the foul line to push the lead to three. A missed 3-pointer by Herro and two more free throws from Powell gave the Bulls a five-point cushion with 20 seconds left. Wilson's steal and Jones' subsequent two foul shots sealed Chicago's victory. Milwaukee jumped out to a 19-6 lead on Herro's first triple less than five minutes in. Green sank a 3-pointer in the closing seconds of the first quarter to give the Bucks a 32-17 advantage. Matas Buzelis' slam pulled the Bulls within seven, but Kasparas Jakucionis and Rollins hit consecutive treys to build the margin to 44-31 with 8:35 left in the first half. Chicago answered again and took a 55-51 lead on Hield's 3-pointer, which stamped a 16-0 run. Kuzma made a layup with three seconds left in the first half to give the Bucks a 62-61 halftime edge. --Field Level Media

item.title: UK government sets out $800 million of AI security funding
item.description: Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence. The biggest chunk of funding will go to a new biosecurity initiative, including £100 million for a laboratory using AI to detect biological threats and £65 million to develop countermeasures against pathogens. AI minister Kanishka Narayan said the aim was for the AI Biosecurity Lab to become a major global institution "bringing together world-leading scientific expertise to protect people from emerging biological threats". Tech companies OpenAI and Anthropic will offer up to £200 million of model credits to the biosecurity initiative Google Deepmind (GOOGL.O) and London-based AI life sciences startup Basecamp Research will offer other assistance Britain's government will give its existing [USN:L8N45E18S TEXT:"AI Security Institute"] an extra £120 million £130 million will go towards new projects to improve cyber defences for critical infrastructure and the wider economy, known as the National Cyber Shield and the National Exposure and Real-Time Vulnerability Centre £60 million will go towards a fund that will invest in British companies using AI to advance robotics, autonomous systems and manufacturing £60 million will be used for AI research and procurement contracts An extra £23 million will go to research on the economic impact of AI £18 million will go to a new chip design academy £15 million will fund a prize for AI solutions to public policy problems, initially focused on healthcare £30 million will go to regional mayors to support local AI work Britain's [USN:L8N42P1O5 TEXT:"National Cyber Security Centre"] will receive an unspecified sum to expand in Manchester Anthropic alone racked up [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"more than $12 billion in operating expenses"] last year ($1 = 0.7472 pounds)

item.title: Thailand welcomes US-Myanmar engagement, expects ASEAN talks on country's future
item.description: Thailand welcomes US engagement with Myanmar and expects discussions at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations' November summit in Manila on how to proceed with the member barred since the 2021 coup, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow told Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
item.content:encoded: Thailand welcomes US engagement with Myanmar and expects discussions at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations' November summit in Manila on how to proceed with the member barred since the 2021 coup, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow told Reuters on Friday. The United States and Myanmar's military-backed government held [USN:L6N46300W TEXT:"talks in Tokyo"] two weeks ago, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it shunned after the coup. "We don't want to see Myanmar isolated, we don't want Myanmar to be an arena for geopolitical rivalry ... so the US engagement is something that we welcome," he said. Engagement "does not mean legitimizing the regime," but aims to encourage peaceful conflict resolution and reconciliation with the opposition, Sihasak, who is also deputy prime minister, added. He said there was "some shift in ASEAN's position," citing Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing's recent visits to Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia, but said it was unclear whether the Manila summit would address restoring Myanmar's full representation. "It's good that we're going to have a very substantive, very extensive, and very in-depth discussion on how to proceed on Myanmar," he said. He also said Thailand and Cambodia could resolve their longstanding land and maritime boundary disputes within 12 to 18 months despite limited progress. "It is possible, everything is possible," he said, cautioning that confidence-building and addressing security concerns along the land border, where clashes have occurred, must come first. Cambodia launched a conciliation process under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea in June to resolve the maritime boundary dispute, after Thailand terminated a 2001 joint development framework in May following deadly border clashes. The first meeting was held about a month ago. "Right now, we haven't achieved, to be very frank, much progress," he said. The maritime dispute centers on overlapping claims to about 26,000 sq km in the Gulf of Thailand, believed to hold oil and gas reserves worth around $300 billion. Thailand wants the boundary defined before discussing resource-sharing, he said. Thailand-EU free-trade talks are in their final stage and could conclude by year-end if there is mutual political will, he added.

item.title: Time for Canadian newcomers to step into spotlight, says Ruggiero
item.description: Canada are entering a critical rebuilding phase ahead of next month's ice hockey Women's World Championship, retired US great Angela Ruggiero told Reuters, after falling to the US in the Milano Cortina Olympic gold medal game.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Canada are entering a critical rebuilding phase ahead of next month's ice hockey Women's World Championship, retired US great Angela Ruggiero told Reuters, after falling to the US in the Milano Cortina Olympic gold medal game. Canada have often had the upper hand in the countries' rivalry, with five Olympic golds to three for the US. But US youth conquered Canadian experience in Milano Cortina, as an American roster loaded with [USN:L8N3Z02EC TEXT:"collegiate talent"] held off the veterans from the north in a spine-tingling finale. Eight months later, Canada announced a World Championship roster with seven tournament debutants at the worlds, with an eye towards replicating US success in developing young up-and-comers. "They're going with a very young team, an inexperienced team that could really work in their favour," said Ruggiero, speaking to Reuters at the Women's Sports Foundation annual gala this week. "They're building for four years from now. So it was a strategic decision." The Hall of Famer helped propel the US to four world golds and made her Olympic debut at 18 years old, when the Americans took the first-ever women's ice hockey gold at the 1998 Games. She said Canada's youth corps should not be underestimated. "I think back to the 2008 World Championship team. We were a very, very young team. And we believed in ourselves. We were able to win those World Championships because of the psychology in the locker room, even though on the ice we weren't the best team," said Ruggiero. "If I were Canada's GM, I think it's the smartest thing to do. Reset the clock, figure out chemistry." The World Championship begins on November 6 after a memorable Milano Cortina Olympics, with the advent of the Professional Women's Hockey League in North America bringing the game into [USN:L8N3ZC0ZU TEXT:"a new era"]. "It was probably all around the most elite, highest skilled, fastest, best brand of women's hockey I have ever seen," said Meghan Duggan, Ruggiero's 2010 Olympic teammate who also appeared at the WSF gala in support of women's sports. "That shows what the professional league is doing to elevate the game."

item.title: Fever GM Amber Cox follows team president out of Indy
item.description: Fever general manager Amber Cox followed team president Kelly Krauskopf out the door in a major shakeup of the front office on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fever general manager Amber Cox followed team president Kelly Krauskopf out the door in a major shakeup of the front office on Friday. Kraskopf resigned earlier in the day and Cox was let go hours later, with the Fever saying the franchise was announcing "the departure of Amber Cox." The franchise wrapped up its best regular season in team history with 26 wins and went to the conference semifinals in Cox's first season in the GM role. Indiana had three players named WNBA All-Stars and two of the league's top three scorers in Kelsey Mitchell (second) and Caitlin Clark. Mitchell is a pending free agent and said she will shop around to find the best fit for her and her family this offseason. Mel Raines, president and CEO of Pacers Sports & Entertainment, said a national search is underway to fill the front-office spots. "Through her two seasons with the Fever, Amber has helped us navigate the seismic growth of the WNBA and our franchise," Raines said. "We're grateful for her contributions and wish her the very best moving forward." --Field Level Media

item.title: Ronaldinho voltará aos gramados pelo italiano Ravenna
item.description: O craque brasileiro Ronaldinho Gaúcho voltará ao futebol competitivo no próximo mês, quando jogará pelo Ravenna, time da terceira divisão italiana, contra o rival local Forlì, no dia 15 de novembro, anunciou o clube da Série C nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O craque brasileiro Ronaldinho Gaúcho voltará ao futebol competitivo no próximo mês, quando jogará pelo Ravenna, time da terceira divisão italiana, contra o rival local Forlì, no dia 15 de novembro, anunciou o clube da Série C nesta sexta-feira. O ex-atacante do Barcelona e do Milan, de 46 anos, que conquistou a Copa do Mundo de 2002 com o Brasil e a Bola de Ouro em 2005, jogou pela última vez em competições oficiais pelo Fluminense, em 2015. Ele se aposentou oficialmente em 2018. O Ravenna contratou Ronaldinho em junho e, posteriormente, ele adquiriu uma participação no clube, que é de propriedade de seu amigo Ignazio Cipriani. Cipriani disse que a iniciativa tinha como objetivo “aproximar toda a cidade do time”. Ronaldinho Gaúcho não chegou a confirmar que jogaria quando chegou à Itália em agosto, embora tenha deixado em aberto a possibilidade de marcar o 300º gol de sua carreira. “Estou aqui para ajudar”, disse ele na ocasião. O clássico contra o Forì será disputado no Stadio Bruno Benelli, em Ravenna. O Ravenna ocupa a segunda colocação do Grupo B da Série C, com 20 pontos em 10 partidas, oito pontos atrás do líder, o Spezia.

item.title: Oregon State breakout WR Jesse Legree re-signs with school for 2027
item.description: Oregon State star freshman receiver Jesse Legree announced Friday that he has re-signed with the Beavers for the 2027 season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oregon State star freshman receiver Jesse Legree announced Friday that he has re-signed with the Beavers for the 2027 season. Legree made the announcement at his former high school, Saint Frances Academy in Baltimore, partly because he was lightly recruited and didn't have a signing day a year ago. "We've built a great culture and it's only going to get bigger from here," Legree told ESPN. "This is going to be the start of a national powerhouse." The 5-foot-10, 172-pound Legree was only a three-star recruit but has exploded onto the scene in Corvallis. He leads the nation with 1,040 receiving yards and 14 touchdown receptions. He is two touchdown catches away from matching the school record held by longtime NFL receiver Brandin Cooks (16 in 2013). Legree has topped 100 yards receiving in all seven games for Oregon State (5-2, 3-0 Pac-12). His top outing was 240 yards - second-most in school history -- against then-No. 13 Texas Tech on Sept. 12. He has caught three touchdown passes twice and grabbed two on three other occasions. He has at least one touchdown catch in each game. His season high for receptions is 10 against San Diego State. He had 191 yards and three scores in the Beavers' 66-14 trouncing of the Aztecs. Legree is averaging 22.6 yards on 46 receptions. Legree has recently been mentioned as a Heisman Trophy candidate. He said he belongs at the top of the conversation. "Never seen a freshman do what I'm doing week in and week out, and I feel like I'm going to continue to do that," Legree said. "And I feel like everybody who doesn't feel like I should be in that conversation will notice by the end of the season that I deserve that, or should at least be in the top-three conversation." Oregon State is averaging 51 points per game during a five-game winning streak in JaMarcus Shepherd's first season as head coach. Legree also held the event during Oregon State's bye week to help attract media attention to the program in hopes of landing athletes for the program. Oregon State also has a quarterback on the rise in Mercer transfer Branden Atkinson, who won the Jerry Rice Award last season as the top freshman in the FCS. Atkinson leads the nation in passing yardage (2,604 yards) and touchdown passes (24) and has thrown just two interceptions for Oregon State. The Beavers return to action on Oct. 31 at Fresno State (4-3, 1-2). --Field Level Media

item.title: JetBlue creditors working with restructuring adviser PJT Partners, WSJ reports
item.description: A senior creditors group for JetBlue Airways is working with restructuring adviser PJT Partners , the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A senior creditors group for JetBlue Airways (JBLU.O) is working with restructuring adviser PJT Partners (PJT.N) , the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. A surge in jet fuel expenses due to the Iran war has [USN:L4N46813M TEXT:"pressured margins for US airlines"] despite higher airfares and steady demand for air travel. Shares of the carrier, which have fallen 42% this year, remained volatile in extended trading JetBlue is in the midst of a financial and operational overhaul to reduce costs and plans to boost its premium offerings As of June 30, JetBlue had $1.66 billion in cash and cash equivalents along with $8.5 billion of debt and finance lease obligations, according to its filings "JetBlue remains confident in its JetForward strategy and the progress being made toward returning to sustained profitability," the company said in an emailed statement PJT did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment

item.title: Ronaldinho volverá a jugar con el club italiano Ravenna
item.description: El brasileño Ronaldinho volverá al fútbol competitivo cuando juegue con el Ravenna de la tercera división italiana contra el Forlì, el 15 de noviembre, anunció el viernes el club de la Serie C.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El brasileño Ronaldinho volverá al fútbol competitivo cuando juegue con el Ravenna de la tercera división italiana contra el Forlì, el 15 de noviembre, anunció el viernes el club de la Serie C. El exdelantero del Barcelona y del AC Milan, de 46 años, que ganó el Mundial de 2002 con Brasil y el Balón de Oro en 2005, jugó por última vez en una competición oficial con el Fluminense en 2015. Se retiró oficialmente en 2018. El Ravenna fichó a Ronaldinho en junio y, posteriormente, este adquirió una participación en el club, propiedad de su amigo Ignazio Cipriani. Ronaldinho no llegó a confirmar que jugaría cuando llegó a Italia en agosto, aunque dejó abierta la posibilidad de marcar el gol número 300 de su carrera.

item.title: Caso de Ebola na Nigéria está ligado ao vírus encontrado no primeiro caso do Quênia, diz ministro da Saúde
item.description: Uma análise genômica do único caso confirmado de Ebola na Nigéria mostra que o vírus está estreitamente relacionado à cepa detectada no primeiro caso registrado no Quênia, disse nesta sexta-feira o ministro da Saúde nigeriano, Muhammad Ali Pate, fornecendo a primeira ligação genética entre os surtos.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
item.content:encoded: Uma análise genômica do único caso confirmado de Ebola na Nigéria mostra que o vírus está estreitamente relacionado à cepa detectada no primeiro caso registrado no Quênia, disse nesta sexta-feira o ministro da Saúde nigeriano, Muhammad Ali Pate, fornecendo a primeira ligação genética entre os surtos. As autoridades nigerianas afirmaram que não há evidências de que o caso do Quênia tenha viajado para a Nigéria ou tenha tido uma conexão direta com o caso nigeriano. Pate disse que os contatos ligados ao caso estão sendo rastreados, colocados em quarentena e testados, com alguns resultados negativos e outros ainda pendentes A Nigéria registrou apenas um caso confirmado de Ebola, de um viajante que havia visitado Uganda Uganda, que faz fronteira com a República Democrática do Congo (RDC) e já enfrentou surtos de Ebola anteriormente, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que continuava livre do Ebola, mas estava reforçando as precauções O Ministério da Saúde de Uganda informou que os formulários de localização de viajantes foram restabelecidos para todos os que chegam ao país, independentemente do país de origem Uganda informou que viajantes com histórico de viagem à RDC, onde o surto teve início, não terão permissão para transitar pelo país

item.title: Ronaldinho to return to action with Italian club Ravenna
item.description: Brazil great Ronaldinho will return to competitive football next month when he plays for Italian third-tier side Ravenna against local rivals Forli on November 15, the Serie C club announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil great Ronaldinho will return to competitive football next month when he plays for Italian third-tier side Ravenna against local rivals Forli on November 15, the Serie C club announced on Friday. The 46-year-old former Barcelona and AC Milan forward, who won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil and the Ballon d'Or in 2005, last played competitively for Brazilian club Fluminense in 2015. He officially retired in 2018. Ravenna signed Ronaldinho in June and he later acquired a stake in the club, which is owned by his friend Ignazio Cipriani. Cipriani said the move was intended "to bring the whole city closer to the team". [USN:L8N44H1KF TEXT:"Ronaldinho"] stopped short of confirming he would play when he arrived in Italy in August, although he left open the prospect of scoring the 300th goal of his career. "I'm here to help," he said at the time. The derby against Forli will take place at Ravenna's Stadio Bruno Benelli. Ravenna sit second in Serie C Group B with 20 points from 10 games, eight behind leaders Spezia.

item.title: Moody's maintient la note souveraine de la France à "Aa3"
item.description: L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1". "La notation Aa3 repose sur l'hypothèse qu'un budget réduisant le déficit sera adopté pour 2027, tandis que les coûts de financement et les tensions sociales s'atténueront quelque peu au cours des prochains mois", indique Moody's dans un communiqué. "Cette annonce déjoue les pronostics déclinistes de nombreux 'experts' et de ceux qui spéculent sur la dette française", a réagi le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu sur son compte X. "Le gouvernement a proposé au Parlement un budget sérieux avec une réduction du déficit permis par des efforts partagés", a poursuivi le Premier ministre, saluant l'action des forces politiques qui, sans majorité, ont accepté d'ouvrir le débat sur le budget dans un calendrier normal. "Ce signal montre à nos prêteurs qu'il existe un chemin. Il nous appartient de le poursuivre pour donner à la France un budget d'ici la fin de l'année, conforme à l'objectif de 5% de déficit", écrit encore Sébastien Lecornu. Le ministre de l'Economie, Roland Lescure, a dit pour sa part prendre acte de la décision de Moody's, qui devrait alléger la pression sur le gouvernement dans un contexte de finances mises à rude épreuve et de troubles sociaux. "Cette décision est la reconnaissance de la solidité de notre économie et de la crédibilité du budget présenté par le gouvernement dans le projet de loi de finances pour 2027, qui vise à poursuivre le rétablissement des comptes publics", a écrit Roland Lescure sur le réseau social Bluesky et dans un communiqué publié par le ministère français des Finances. Une dégradation par Moody's de la note de la France aurait aligné celle-ci sur les décisions prises en 2025 par [USN:L5N3VY1MP TEXT:"Standard & Poor's"] et [USN:L5N3UZ1HN TEXT:"Fitch"]. La France peine cependant à maîtriser ses finances publiques avec une situation qui s'est aggravée depuis que les élections législatives anticipées de 2024 ont abouti à un Parlement divisé en trois grands blocs, sans majorité, provoquant ainsi une quasi paralysie politique. Selon le projet de loi de finances, la France table sur un déficit budgétaire à 5,4% du produit intérieur brut (PIB) pour cette année et le gouvernement prévoit de ramener ce déficit à 5,0% en 2027. La dette publique, quant à elle, devrait atteindre 119,3% du PIB cette année et pourrait grimper à 121,7% en 2027, alors que ce ratio était de 115,7% en 2025. Une baisse à l'avenir de la note de la France pourrait réduire le nombre d'investisseurs capables ou disposés à détenir des obligations françaises ou à les accepter en garantie. Les coûts d'emprunt de la France dépassent déjà ceux de pays moins bien notés comme l'Italie, les investisseurs s'inquiétant du niveau du déficit budgétaire – l'un des plus importants de la zone euro – et à l'incertitude liée à l'approche de l'élection présidentielle, prévue les 18 avril et 2 mai. Les sondages laissent entrevoir une possible victoire de Marine Le Pen, candidate du parti d'extrême droite Rassemblement national (RN), contre Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader de La France Insoumise (LFI), perçu comme une formation d'extrême gauche.

item.title: Francia se libra de la rebaja de la calificación de Moody's mientras se enfrenta a los disturbios
item.description: Moody's evitó el viernes una rebaja de la calificación crediticia de Francia, lo que alivió la presión sobre un Gobierno que lucha por contener el malestar social y reforzar sus maltrechas finanzas.
item.dc:creator: Leigh Thomas, Dhara Ranasinghe
item.content:encoded: Moody's evitó el viernes una rebaja de la calificación crediticia de Francia, lo que alivió la presión sobre un Gobierno que lucha por contener el malestar social y reforzar sus maltrechas finanzas. Moody's afirmó que había concluido una revisión periódica de su calificación, manteniéndola en Aa3, con perspectiva negativa desde el pasado mes de octubre. Los mercados de bonos ya habían descontado una rebaja, lo que habría alineado a Moody's con Standard & Poor's y Fitch, que ya habían tomado medidas mientras Francia luchaba por controlar sus finanzas públicas tras unas elecciones anticipadas de 2024 que dieron lugar a un parlamento sin mayoría y a una parálisis política. El Ministerio de Hacienda francés señaló en un comunicado que el hecho de que Moody's mantuviera inalterada su calificación reflejaba la "credibilidad del presupuesto que el Gobierno ha presentado en el proyecto de ley de presupuestos para 2027, diseñado para mantener nuestras finanzas públicas en la senda de la recuperación". El Gobierno está teniendo dificultades para aprobar el proyecto de ley en el Parlamento, donde los partidos de la oposición podrían negarse a llegar a un acuerdo, rechazar la legislación y derrocarlo mediante un voto de censura. "La calificación Aa3 parte de la base de que se aprobará un presupuesto de reducción del déficit para 2027, mientras que los costos de financiación y las tensiones sociales remitirán en cierta medida en los próximos meses", señaló Moody's en un comunicado. Los costos de financiación de Francia ya superan a los de países con calificaciones más bajas, como Italia. Los inversionistas se muestran preocupados por el déficit presupuestario —uno de los mayores de la zona del euro— y por las elecciones presidenciales del 18 de abril y el 2 de mayo del próximo año, en las que las encuestas sugieren que la extrema derecha podría ganar. Las imágenes televisivas de las protestas del fin de semana, que degeneraron en disturbios y saqueos, ponen de relieve la dificultad política que supone sacar adelante los recortes presupuestarios. Esto contribuyó a que, el jueves, la prima de riesgo de la deuda pública francesa frente a los bonos alemanes —considerados un valor refugio— alcanzara su nivel más alto en 15 años, mientras que el rendimiento del bono de referencia francés a 10 años se situó en el 5,14%, su nivel más alto desde julio de 2002. Moody's afirmó a principios de este mes que la capacidad del Gobierno francés para superar la "fragmentación en el Parlamento" sería el factor clave para su próxima decisión sobre la calificación. Esa tarea parece más difícil después de que las violentas protestas por la falta de financiación de las escuelas se intensificaran el fin de semana hasta convertirse en disturbios durante las manifestaciones masivas contra el costo de la vida. El Gobierno se ha negado a destinar más fondos a la educación o a aumentar el salario mínimo, y están previstas nuevas protestas el sábado. En el Parlamento, la Cámara Baja ha rechazado algunas medidas de ahorro clave del presupuesto para 2027, que prevé un déficit del 5% del PIB frente al 5,4% de este año.

item.title: Judge approves defunct talc supplier's $535 million settlement with Berkshire affiliate
item.description: A US bankruptcy judge has approved a $535 million settlement between a defunct talc supplier and Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance unit, overruling objections that the deal would provide too little money to resolve lawsuits alleging the company’s talc contained asbestos and caused cancer.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: A US bankruptcy judge has approved a $535 million settlement between a defunct talc supplier and Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance unit, overruling objections that the deal would provide too little money to resolve lawsuits alleging the company’s talc contained asbestos and caused cancer. US bankruptcy judge Michael Kaplan in New Jersey on Thursday ruled that Whittaker Clark & Daniels' settlement was fair and reasonable, based on his evaluation of the talc litigation claims and the claimants' ability to win judgments against the company's former corporate parents. The settlement aims to resolve liabilities of Berkshire's National Indemnity Co., which purchased Whittaker Clark & Daniels and assumed its liabilities in 2007, and other former corporate affiliates like chemical distributor Brenntag. Whittaker filed for bankruptcy in 2023, citing a “deluge” of lawsuits from roughly 2,700 people who alleged the company supplied asbestos-contaminated talc to makers of cosmetics, chemicals and other products, causing cancer. Talc claimants argued that the settlement was an insider deal between the defunct Whittaker and its corporate owners and affiliates, which resolved those companies' liabilities without any input from talc claimants. The deal was designed to shield well-heeled companies that could be liable for billions of dollars in talc claims, like National Indemnity Co., Berkshire Hathaway, former corporate affiliate Brenntag, and others with a shared corporate history, according to talc claimants. The talc claimants had asked the court for permission to sue Brenntag, National Indemnity Co., and other potential corporate successors for a higher contribution, but Kaplan denied that request. Kaplan ruled that Whittaker was responsible for suing those companies for indemnification and contribution to the bankruptcy, and that other plaintiffs could not usurp legal claims that were property of the debtor. Suzanne Ratcliffe, an attorney who represents asbestos claimants in the bankruptcy, said that the ruling was "wrong" and that she planned to appeal. "This order blesses a greed-fueled insider 'settlement' between Whittaker and multi-billionaires — including Berkshire Hathaway affiliates — a settlement which no victim wants or asked for,” Ratcliffe said in a statement. The talc claimants have filed a petition with the US Supreme Court to challenge an earlier ruling in the case, saying that debtors should not be able to use bankruptcy to block plaintiffs who want to sue a bankrupt company's non-bankrupt owners. The Supreme Court has not acted on that petition. Whittaker operated one of the largest talc and industrial compound supply and distribution businesses in the US in the 1970s and 1980s, but it ceased operations in 2004. Its corporate existence since then has largely been devoted to resolving a growing wave of legal claims related to its decades-long production of talc and industrial chemicals. Brenntag acquired Whittaker's operating assets in 2004, while leaving the asbestos liabilities with Whittaker. National Indemnity Co. later bought Whittaker and assumed its remaining assets and liabilities. Brenntag has denied being responsible for the defunct company's talc liabilities. The case is Whittaker Clark & Daniels Inc. et al., US Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, 23-1357 For Whittaker Clark & Daniels: Chad Husnick and Joshua Sussberg of Kirkland & Ellis LLP, Michael Sirota and Felice Yudkin of Cole Schotz P.C., among others. For the official committee of talc claimants: Arthur Abramowitz of Sherman Silverstein, among others For talc claimant Juliet Gray: Suzanne Ratcliffe and Clay Thompson of Maune Raichle Hartley French

item.title: Fiscal general Costa Rica dice nuevas operaciones conjuntas con la DEA se enfocarán en políticos y empresarios
item.description: Costa Rica intensificará su cooperación con la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA) de Estados Unidos para perseguir delincuentes que el fiscal general del país, recientemente reelecto, denomina "narcotraficantes invisibles", incluyendo empresarios y políticos que ocultan sus presuntos vínculos con el tráfico de drogas tras una imagen pública respetable.
item.dc:creator: Alvaro Murillo
item.content:encoded: Costa Rica intensificará su cooperación con la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA) de Estados Unidos para perseguir delincuentes que el fiscal general del país, recientemente reelecto, denomina "narcotraficantes invisibles", incluyendo empresarios y políticos que ocultan sus presuntos vínculos con el tráfico de drogas tras una imagen pública respetable. El fiscal general Carlo Díaz, que se ha enfrentado en repetidas ocasiones al Gobierno de la presidenta Laura Fernández, fue reelecto el lunes por el Poder Judicial para un nuevo mandato de cuatro años. En una entrevista concedida a Reuters el jueves, afirmó que los investigadores no mostrarían clemencia alguna si los implicados ocupaban puestos de alto nivel. “Esta segunda etapa va enfocada a objetivos que hemos denominado ‘narcotraficantes invisibles’, declaró Díaz, tras una fase inicial de misiones conjuntas dirigidas contra miembros de organizaciones criminales. “Son personas empresarias, a veces profesionales, a veces políticos, que son exitosos en la sociedad o personas muy visibles. Sin embargo, detrás de esa fachada está la vinculación directa con ese tipo de actividades”, añadió. Díaz también elogió la capacidad de Costa Rica para extraditar a sus propios ciudadanos a Estados Unidos como un hito en la lucha contra la delincuencia transnacional y señaló que se había extraditado a seis personas y que había otros 25 procedimientos de extradición en curso. La oficina de la DEA no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El Gobierno de Costa Rica ya ha colaborado anteriormente con la DEA para detener a decenas de narcotraficantes, a quienes las autoridades costarricenses consideran responsables del aumento de las tasas de homicidios en los últimos años en esta nación centroamericana, que durante mucho tiempo había gozado de paz. Las autoridades estadounidenses han señalado que Costa Rica actúa como un corredor clave para el traslado de narcóticos desde Sudamérica hacia Estados Unidos. Fernández, una aliada conservadora del presidente Donald Trump, ha alineado estrechamente a Costa Rica con Washington en materia de seguridad, sumándose a la iniciativa[USN:L6N45E101 TEXT:" "Escudo de las Américas""] del presidente estadounidense contra el narcotráfico y el crimen organizado. DIVISIONES POLÍTICAS Díaz afirmó que los responsables de la DEA le habían expresado directamente su preocupación por las divisiones políticas e institucionales en Costa Rica, que, según él, están obstaculizando la lucha contra el crimen organizado. Se ha enfrentado en repetidas ocasiones con Fernández y con su predecesor, Rodrigo Chaves, acusando al Gobierno de intentar debilitar al poder judicial. A pesar de respaldar una cooperación más estrecha con la DEA, Díaz rechazó la sugerencia de Fernández del mes pasado de que Costa Rica podría beneficiarse de la presencia de [USN:L6N44W128 TEXT:"fuerzas estadounidenses"] operando en su territorio. “Si nos enfocamos en dar los recursos que necesita la Fuerza Pública, esta podría tomar el control territorial sin necesidad de traer fuerzas armadas de otros países”, afirmó. El gobierno de Fernández ha construido una prisión con capacidad para 5.100 reclusos siguiendo el modelo de la campaña de seguridad de El Salvador, un enfoque que Díaz ha cuestionado en el marco de sus enfrentamientos con el Gobierno. Afirmó que la prisión podría aliviar el hacinamiento, pero que por sí sola no frenaría el crimen organizado y subrayó que el panorama delictivo de Costa Rica difiere notablemente de el de El Salvador. La tasa de homicidios en Costa Rica, considerada durante mucho tiempo uno de los países más seguros de la región, alcanzó su máximo en 2023 con 17,2 por cada 100.000 habitantes, lo que supone 906 asesinatos, con una ligera disminución en 2024 y 2025. "Este es uno de los momentos más complejos de nuestra historia", afirmó Díaz. "(La DEA) está muy consciente de la situación".

item.title: Morocco expects stable fiscal deficit despite tax cuts in 2027
item.description: Morocco expects a steady fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP despite higher spending on social programmes and tax cuts, newly appointed finance and economy minister Fouzi Lekjaa said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
item.content:encoded: Morocco expects a steady fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP despite higher spending on social programmes and tax cuts, newly appointed finance and economy minister Fouzi Lekjaa said on Friday. The economy is expected to grow 3.7% in 2027, down from a forecast of 4.7% this year, assuming an average crop year, Lekjaa told members of parliament while presenting the 2027 draft budget. Morocco announced a [USN:S8N3UN004 TEXT:"new government coalition"] last week following [USN:S8N3SV012 TEXT:"September 23 elections"], placing priority on purchasing power, social services and youth employment, one year after [USN:L2N3VI14N TEXT:"GenZ protests"] and the [USN:L6N4410N7 TEXT:"Ceuta migration crisis"] in July. The government's social policies in previous years have been weakened by an [USN:L6N3VN095 TEXT:"economic model"] that prioritised market forces over regulation, fostering monopolistic practices, rent-seeking and quick profits, Lekjaa said. "Savage capitalism and neo-liberalism" have been at the heart of social tension, he said, urging a stronger role for the state in combating corruption, conflicts of interest and monopolies, while safeguarding food and energy sovereignty. In total, the government plans to spend 62 billion dirhams ($6.3 billion) next year on measures aimed at improving social services, boosting purchasing power and reducing inequalities, Lekjaa said. The measures include reforming distribution channels for basic goods, promoting youth employment and exempting salaries of less than 10,000 dirhams a month, which would account for 87% of all employees, from income tax, he said. The package also includes pension increases, higher financial aid for needy families and electricity subsidies. The health budget would rise 7% to 45.5 billion dirhams, while education spending would increase 4.6% to 121 billion dirhams, according to the draft budget. The draft also authorises defence expenditure commitments of up to 190.5 billion dirhams. Public debt is forecast to decline to 66.9% of GDP in 2027 from 67.5% this year, the budget document showed. The government proposes raising to 40% the tax rate on profits above 100 million dirhams earned by fuel distribution companies, a sector previously sanctioned by competition authorities for anti-competitive practices. The draft budget increases excise taxes on soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, cigarettes and e-cigarettes. The government's financing requirement is expected to fall 7.4% to 159 billion dirhams in 2027 as it seeks to balance domestic and external borrowing "depending on market conditions," according to the draft budget.

item.description: Oct 23 : Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum won the Portugal Pro in thumping tubes on Friday, claiming her first victory of the year and jumping to the top of the rankings with just two events of surfing's world tour remaining.California's Griffin Colapinto scored a near-perfect barrel to come
